import sys
from awsglue.transforms import *
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
  
sc = SparkContext.getOrCreate()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
import pyspark.sql.functions as f
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, LongType, StringType

url='https://services.arcgis.com/g1fRTDLeMgspWrYp/arcgis/rest/services/311_All_Service_Calls/FeatureServer/0/query'
metaurl='https://services.arcgis.com/g1fRTDLeMgspWrYp/arcgis/rest/services/311_All_Service_Calls/FeatureServer/0?f=json'

mresponse=requests.get(metaurl)
mdata=mresponse.json()

page_size=mdata.get('maxRecordCount', 1000)
callSchema = StructType([
    StructField("CaseID", LongType(), True),
    StructField("CaseStatus", StringType(), True),
    StructField("Category", StringType(), True),
    StructField("ClosedDateTime", LongType(), True),
    StructField("CouncilDistrict", LongType(), True),
    StructField("Department", StringType(), True),
    StructField("LateYesNo", StringType(), True),
    StructField("OBJECTID", LongType(), True),
    StructField("ObjectDescription", StringType(), True),
    StructField("OpenedDateTime", LongType(), True),
    StructField("ReasonName", StringType(), True),
    StructField("ReportEndingDate", LongType(), True),
    StructField("ReportStartingDate", LongType(), True),
    StructField("SLADate", LongType(), True),
    StructField("SourceID", StringType(), True),
    StructField("TypeName", StringType(), True),
    StructField("XCOORD", LongType(), True),
    StructField("YCOORD", LongType(), True)
])
months=12
startYear=datetime(2023,1,1)
i=1
cont=True

while (startYear.year, startYear.month) <= (datetime.now().year, datetime.now().month) and cont: 
    nextMonth=startYear + relativedelta(months=1)
    offset=0
    print(f'processing {startYear} / {nextMonth}')
    
    while True: 

        params={
            'where': f"OpenedDateTime >= DATE '{startYear.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}' AND OpenedDateTime < '{nextMonth.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}'",
            'outFields': '*',
            'f': 'json',
            'resultOffset': offset,
            'resultRecordCount': page_size
        }
        
        
        response=requests.get(url, params=params)
        data=response.json()

        features=data.get('features', [])
        
        if not features: 
            print('no features')
            cont=False
            break

        attributes=[f.get('attributes',{}) for f in features]

        df=spark.createDataFrame(attributes, schema=callSchema)
        df=df.withColumn('opened_ts', f.to_timestamp(f.from_unixtime(f.col('OpenedDateTime')/1000))).withColumn('year_month', f.date_format(f.col('opened_ts'), 'yyyy-MM'))
        df.write.mode('append').partitionBy('year_month').parquet('s3://sanantonio-311-calls/bronze/')
        if not data.get('exceededTransferLimit', False): 
            break

        offset+=len(features)
        
    startYear = startYear + relativedelta(months=1)
job.commit()
